race.comment: CHAMPEZE (5) is better than she showed last start when getting back and never firing overt 1200m. Out in trip now is a query, but she'll be back in the run and is sure to be finishing off strongly if she can bounce back to her best form. SOUTHLAND (1) didn't fire first-up off the break but was a second-up winner here last campaign. A good draw helps and he'll be hard to hold out if he improves as he did last campaign. CANTILEVER (2) is better suited coming back to this trip with the visors replacing the blinkers. PRINCE EPAULETTE (4) gets the blinkers back on today and is not to be discounted.
